notes.title: Game Walkthrough
notes.content:
For those who may run into trouble during your adventures, here is a great text walkthrough of Eternal Concord:
https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/android/255152-eternal-concord/faqs/77576

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Three more days until release!
notes.content:
I got some good news over this weekend that Steam has approved the build for Eternal Concord, so everything is now ready for Thursday's release! I look forward to all of you playing my game and letting me know what you think!

I hope your week goes well. Take care and I will see you back here on Thursday!

notes.title: Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello all!

Due to some sickness in the family, my final testing of the release build for Eternal Concord has been delayed slightly. Luckily everyone is well now and I am back to testing.

The new release date is

[h1][b]Thursday, September 12th[/b][/h1]

Be sure to mark your calendars. Thank you all for your patience and support!
